title: Diegetic Practice Spaces, Training Scenes & Simulations

implementation_scope.purpose: Define deterministic read-only contracts for optional diegetic practice spaces, training scenes and simulations over frozen ALP-01/02/03/04 learning and recognition semantics while preserving Character Progression, Projects, World/Scene, GCL, ISE and MAL mutation authority.
authorized: explicit practice-space identity, kind, scope, author and provenance
optional participation policy with no universal gating
practice goals and training markers tied to frozen ALP taxonomy families
read-only links to Character Progression, Projects, World/Scene, GCL, ISE and MAL owner objects
simulation/training context and safe outcome projection without canonical owner-state mutation
authorized evidence projection for practice observations with hidden or unauthorized evidence remaining unknown
deterministic ordering and receipts independent of supplied practice-space, participant, goal and evidence ordering
not_authorized: automatic XP, advancement, capability or reward grants from practice participation
direct Character Progression, Reputation/Relationship/Faction, World/Scene or Project mutation
universal permission or unrelated capability gates
ALP-06 or later ALP behavior beyond explicit reserved references
provider activation, tester distribution, release or deployment
